_about: Promotions the posters work into existing slots (Alan 2026-11-15: 'Let's add the promotions to the posting on socials'). One promotion post a day per platform, in the first Reel slot at or after slot_from_ct (Central); the active promotions take turns by day. Volume does not go up. Copy rules: plain, concrete numbers, seller-first, never promise views or sales, never a category count; the clip's own question still ends the caption. A promotion posts only between start and end (Central dates, end exclusive) and only on its platforms. GUARD 2b (11-16): a promo line goes in this file only after its payout has one logged redemption. founding: HELD 11-16 (start moved to its end date, so it never runs). Coupon founding-dealer-29 and FOUNDINGDEALER are active and the code is on main, but no redemption or sandbox run is logged yet (the trial path applies the discount only at the trial_will_end webhook). When the Stripe features thread logs a sandbox run, set start to that day; end 2026-12-01 matches the founding message window, and take it out when FOUNDINGDEALER is used up or switched off. storefront: the plain plan (free 90 days for first-time dealers, then $49 a month) fills the dealer turn meanwhile; it links /dealers without the founding offer. share: the invite clause ('you both get a free 7-day boost once their first listing has been live 3 days') was held by Guard 11-16 and restored the same day after the share thread logged a real-database run of the referral cron code (GROWTH-LOG 2026-11-16); keep the words tied to the invited seller's first listing being live. reward_live stays false until the share thread confirms the $49 Stripe credit passed its sandbox test. lines_reward follow app PR #351: the reward comes one week after the invited person's first payment, and the 90 free days don't count as a payment. boost (11-17, Push paid boosts everywhere thread): paid listing boosts beside the free ones; prices from the live Stripe catalog; HELD by start=end until the first paid boost is confirmed running, then set end to null. Never say a boost brings views or sales: only that it ranks ahead of unboosted listings in search and the home feed for the days paid.

promos.head: FOUNDING DEALER PRICE
promos.ig_cta: To open a storefront at the founding price, type yardswaps.com/o in your browser.
lines: First-time dealers get a YardSwaps storefront free for 90 days. For our first 100 dealers, the first 3 paid months after that are $29 a month instead of $49. Listing stays free either way.

A storefront puts every unit you have on one page, and you can import them from your website. It is free for 90 days for first-time dealers. Our first 100 dealers then pay $29 a month for 3 months, then $49.
No cap on listings, bulk upload, and stats on every unit. First-time dealers pay nothing for 90 days, and our first 100 pay $29 a month for the first 3 paid months instead of $49.

promos.head: SHARE YOUR SELLER PAGE
lines: Your seller page is one link to everything you have listed. In the YardSwaps app, open Profile and tap Share my page, then text it to anyone asking what you have. Invite a seller with your invite link and you both get a free 7-day boost once their first listing has been live 3 days.

Open Profile in the YardSwaps app and tap Share my page. One link shows all your listings, so post it in your groups or send it to past customers. Sellers you invite get a free 7-day boost and so do you, once their first listing has been live 3 days.
lines_reward: Open Profile in the YardSwaps app and tap Share my page. The link carries your invite: when a seller signs up from it, you both get a free 7-day boost once their first listing has been live 3 days. If they pay for a storefront, you get a free month of yours one week after their first payment, or 5 free boosts if you don't have one. Their first 90 days are free and don't count as a payment.

Your seller page is one link to all your listings. Tap Share my page on your profile and send it around. Anyone who signs up from it is your invite. If they pay for a storefront, you get a free month of yours, or 5 free boosts if you don't have one, one week after their first payment. Their 90 free days come first and don't count.

promos.head: BOOST A LISTING
lines: Listing on YardSwaps is free. If you want a listing higher in search, tap Boost on it: 1 day $2.99, 3 days $7.99 or 7 days $14.99, one-time, no subscription. A boost puts it ahead of unboosted listings in search and the home feed for those days.

Every 4 listings you post earns a free 7-day boost, up to 5. Need one sooner? Tap Boost on your listing: 1 day $2.99, 3 days $7.99 or 7 days $14.99. It puts the listing ahead of unboosted ones in search and the home feed.

Boost often? A dealer storefront includes 5 seven-day boosts every paid month at $49 a month, and first-time dealers get the first 90 days free. Bought one at a time, five 7-day boosts are $74.95. Single boosts start at $2.99 for a day.
